en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a wide river with several boats and barges moored along the embankment. On the left side stands a long row of ornate multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with mansard roofs and a central domed structure, forming a classic European riverside boulevard. In the distance on the right is a slender suspension bridge crossing the river. The image is framed by an irregular white vignette border typical of old postcards.
